title: DIY plug-in solar gains momentum in the US
summary: Traditional plug-in solar kits include a few solar panels and a small microinverter that ties itself to the electrical grid. People operating a plug-in solar system in sunnier climates with maxed out solar arrays will recoup costs much faster.
